about: S-admin - the frame data of admin-1 / -2 / -3 and the undrawn states of /admin (PLAN 4.1 rule 7). Every fixture is a list of edits over a recording of the admin account (GET /admin/stats, /admin/moderation, /admin/moderation/:id, /admin/users), or a stub with an empty body for an error status or a mutation answer (R26). Accounts: A = admin@ (frames and every state but one), M = user@ (forbidden). Nothing is written live by this package: approve, reject and resolve are never fired against the backend; their outcomes are fixtures.

admin-1.why: The recording of A holds 49 users (45 / 3 / 1), 1660 exercises, 4 media files, 21 sessions and 2 audit events, and the queue owners are coach@tracker.local / demo.coach.feher.tamas@tracker.local. The frame draws 19 users (15 / 3 / 1), 1656, 3, "3 aktív munkamenet · 14 naplóesemény" and the shared @pelda.hu owners. The edits set those figures and owners; the three submissions, their order, names, ages (8 / 3 / 1 days at the recording instant) and media counts are the recording.

admin-2.why: admin-1 data, and the frame opens the SECOND submission ("Demó – Bolgár kitörés", _subcheck wrongItem). Its recorded review is edited to the frame where the seed answers other words (owner, description, steps, muscles, equipment - see the edits). The submitted image is the seed's blank upload (masked in the comparison: the frame draws a barbell photograph). The frame is drawn scrolled (switch at y 72); the capture cannot scroll by a distance, so the same state is also captured 404 pt taller (admin-2-tall) and cropped at y 404 for the pair.

admin-3.why: admin-1 figures, and the account list as the frame draws it: the recorded first eight rows re-valued to the eight @pelda.hu accounts (roles, registration dates, client counts, the illustrative jelszócsere flag; the letiltva flag of molnar.zsolt is NOT set: no recording holds a disabled account, so a disabledAt value cannot be schema-checked (R26) and the illustrative flag of the frame stays undrawn), the other sixteen removed and no page cap (nextCursor null). Drawn scrolled like admin-2 (admin-3-tall).

admin-2-tall.why: admin-2 exactly, in a viewport 404 pt taller than the frame so the whole page is drawn; the pair crops it at y 404 (the frame is drawn scrolled to the section switch).

admin-3-tall.why: admin-3 exactly, 404 pt taller; the pair crops it at y 404.
